comment: One fixture for both twins of the rule 'only the version of a golang image line changed': scripts/ci/pr_classify.py (golang_image_bump_only) and tests/conformance/registry/lockcode.go (GolangImageBumpOnly). kind=compose is read by both, kind=dockerfile by the Python side only. The CR, Unicode-digit and Unicode-space cases are smuggles found by an independent review.

cases.name: 491 compose: the toolchain image tag moved
cases.base:
services:
  build:
    image: golang:1.27.1
    environment:
      LH_BASE_URL: lh
cases.head:
services:
  build:
    image: golang:1.27.2
    environment:
      LH_BASE_URL: lh

cases.name: compose: unchanged is not a bump
cases.head:
services:
  build:
    image: golang:1.27.1

cases.name: compose: another image family
cases.head:
services:
  build:
    image: node:1.27.2

cases.name: compose: a suffix appears
cases.head:
services:
  build:
    image: golang:1.27.2-alpine

cases.name: compose: a line is added
cases.head:
services:
  build:
    image: golang:1.27.2
    command: x

cases.name: compose: the environment changed too
cases.base:
services:
  build:
    image: golang:1.27.1
    environment:
      LH_BASE_URL: lh
cases.head:
services:
  build:
    image: golang:1.27.2
    environment:
      LH_BASE_URL: vl

  image: golang:1.27.2
